objective: sum over planning years (all but the last) and industries of labor_per_unit_output * production + labor_per_unit_capacity * extra_capacity

initial_stock.description: Stock of the industry's output available at the start of year 1
initial_stock.label: initial stock

initial_capacity.description: Productive capacity before any capacity is built
initial_capacity.label: initial productive capacity

external_demand.description: Output consumed outside the modelled industries every year (also sets the steady-state production levels)
external_demand.label: exogenous consumption demand

labor_per_unit_output.description: Manpower used per unit of output
labor_per_unit_output.label: manpower per unit of output

labor_per_unit_capacity.description: Manpower used per unit of capacity built
labor_per_unit_capacity.label: manpower per unit of capacity built

supplier.description: Industry whose output is used as input
supplier.label: supplying industry

input_per_unit_output.description: Supplier output needed one year earlier per unit of the user's output; a missing row means 0
input_per_unit_output.label: input per unit of output

input_per_unit_capacity.description: Supplier output needed two years earlier per unit of the user's new capacity; a missing row means 0
input_per_unit_capacity.label: input per unit of capacity built

year.description: Year label; the last year stands for the steady state beyond the horizon
year.label: year

order.description: Position in the horizon (1 = first year)
order.label: year order

decision_variables.production[year, industry]: output of the industry in the year (>= 0; 0 in the first year)
decision_variables.stock[year, industry]: output held in stock at the end of the year (>= 0; every year but the last)
decision_variables.extra_capacity[year, industry]: capacity that becomes available in the year (>= 0; only from the third year and not in the last year)

constraints.balance[year, industry]: for every year but the last: production + previous closing stock (initial_stock in year 1) = sum over users of input_per_unit_output * next year's production + input_per_unit_capacity * capacity built two years later + external_demand + closing stock
constraints.steady_production[industry]: last-year production >= the steady-state level x solving x - A x = external_demand
constraints.capacity[year, industry]: for every year but the last: production <= initial_capacity + extra_capacity built up to that year
